row.team_price_text: Pro: $18/mo billed annually, 3 creators included (+$6/mo per extra creator)
row.evidence: Dubble's pricing page lists SSO (SAML) and user administration only on Enterprise ("Talk to us"), with no SCIM or provisioning feature on any plan, and its help centre and API reference document no SCIM or user endpoints.
row.notes: Unchanged status (none). Pricing changed since June: the Team plan ($12/user/mo, 5-user minimum) is gone; Pro is $18/mo billed annually with 3 creators included and $6/mo per additional creator (llms.txt: $24/mo monthly, $8/seat monthly). Per-user figure of $6 is the annual per-creator rate. SAML SSO moved from Pro (June) to Enterprise only. Organization admin and API access are marked 'coming soon' on the pricing page, while llms.txt lists API access on Pro; the public API covers collections, guides and webhooks only. Team members are invited and removed manually in Workspace Settings.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $18 USD per month, billed annually (3 creators included, +$6/month per additional creator)
plans.notes: Flat base for 3 creators; $6/creator/mo annual, $8 monthly per llms.txt. Google SSO only (not SAML).

scim.notes: No SCIM or automated provisioning is mentioned on the pricing page, llms.txt, any of the 46 help-centre URLs, or the public API reference.

limitations.text: API access is shown as 'coming soon' on the pricing page.

user_api.notes: The Dubble Public API covers collections, guides and webhooks only; no user, workspace-member or role endpoints are documented.

fallbacks.notes: Members are invited by email and removed manually; extra seats are prorated and credited on removal.

open_questions: No SAML SSO setup guide is published, so supported IdPs and JIT behaviour are unknown.
Which plans include the Dubble API is unclear ('coming soon' on the pricing page vs 'API access' on Pro in llms.txt).
